title: Every internal Odoo user can delete the chatter record of a decision
content:
`addons/mail/security/ir.model.access.csv` grants `base.group_user` the permission tuple `1,1,1,1` on `model_mail_message` — read, write, create and unlink. `base.group_user` is every internal employee, not an administrative group. `mail.tracking.value.mail_message_id` is declared `ondelete='cascade'`, so removing the message silently takes the field-level diffs with it.

`mail.message.unlink()` is an ordinary model method gated only by `check_access('unlink')`, which that ACL satisfies. Three documented context switches — `tracking_disable`, `mail_notrack` and a blessed `bypass_audit` token — provide further ways past tracking, and `account.lock_exception` is a first-class bypass model whose `reason` is nullable, which applies to everyone when `user_id` is null and never expires when `end_datetime` is null.

Worth stating in Odoo's favour: editing is blocked — *"Messages with tracking values cannot be modified"* — and there is no automatic pruning of `mail.message`. The weakness is deletion by ordinary users, not mutation or drift.
description: The ACL grants base.group_user full CRUD including unlink on mail.message, and tracking values cascade with it, so no administrative privilege is needed.
